MANAGEMENT OF NSTE – ACS  
 
 
The HEART Score for Chest Pain in the ED 
History 
* Highly suspicious * 2 points 
* Moderately suspicious * 1 point 
* Slightly / non-suspicious * 0 points 
ECG 
* Significant ST depression * 2 points 
* Nonspecific repolarisation  * 1 point 
* Normal * 0 points 
Age 
* ≥ 65 years * 2 points 
* > 45 - < 65 years * 1 point 
* ≤ 45 years * 0 points 
Risk Factors 
* ≥ 3 risk factors * 2 points 
* 1 or 2 risk factors * 1 point 
* No risk factors * 0 points 
Troponin 
* ≥ 3 x normal limit * 2 points 
* > 1 - < 3 x normal limit * 1 point 
* ≤ normal limit * 0 points 
Risk Factors: Diabetes Mellitus, current or recent (<1 month) smoker, 
Hypertension, Hypercholestrolaemia, Family History, Obesity  
Score 0 - 3 (low risk) 2.5% MACE over next 6 weeks 
Score 4 - 6 (intermediate risk) 20.3% MACE over next 6 weeks 
Score 7 - 10 (high risk) 72.7% MACE over next 6 weeks 
MACE = Major Adverse Cardiac Event 
	
NSTE - ACS 
High Risk Unstable Angina (UA) / NSTEMI 
* ST depression ≥ 0.5mm (see box for criteria) 
* ST elevation > 0.5mm but < 1mm 
* Dynamic inverted t-waves                                                        
  i.e. T-waves previously been upright but are inverted  
  when the patient has chest  pain 
 
TIMI Risk Score for Patients with NSTE - ACS 
1 point for each variable present 
* Age ≥ 65years   1 
* ≥ 3 risk factors for CAD                1 
   -Family history 
   -Hypertension 
   -Hypercholestrolaemia 
   -Diabetes Mellitus 
   -Smoker 
* Aspirin use in last 7 days              1 
* Recent, severe symptoms of angina                 1 
   - ≥ 2 events in last 24hrs 
* Elevated cardiac markers               1 
* ST deviation ≥ 0.5mm                 1 
* Prior coronary artery stenosis ≥ 50%                  1 
Score: 0-1   Low Risk (5% #) 
              2   Low Risk (8% #) 
              3   Intermediate Risk (13% #) 
              4   Intermediate Risk (20% #) 
              5   High Risk (26% #) 
 # risk of death, recurrent or new MI,  or need  
       for  urgent revascularisation 
Start Adjunctive Treatments 
* Heparin 
   LMWH:  Clexane® 30mg IV stat then 1mg/kg SC after 15 min 
                                             or if no LMWH 
   Heparin: 60IU/kg (max 4000IU) IV stat then infusion with 12IU/kg/hr  
                                           (max 1000IU/hr) 
 
* Thienopyridines 
   Clopidogrel (Plavix®) 300mg stat po 
 
* Statin 
   Simvastatin (Zocor®) 40mg stat po 
 
* β blocker (if no contraindications - see box) 
    Atenolol (Tenormin®) 50mg stat po 
  
Calculate & document 
TIMI / HEART score 
 
ST SEGMENT CRITERIA HIGH RISK 
NSTE-ACS 
* J-point ST segment depression ≥ 
0.5mm in leads V2 and V3 
and/or 
* J-point ST segment depression ≥ 
1mm in all other leads 
* Discuss with & transfer to cardiology CMJAH 
* Admit to HCU / Medicine 
 
Contraindications  
β Blockers 
* Haemodynamic instability 
* Heart failure 
* Pulmonary oedema 
* SBP < 100 mmHg 
* Bradycardia (HR ≤ 60 bpm)  
* AV block 2° or 3° 
* Asthma  
Dr R Gihwala CMJAH Emergency Department June 2020
